decision: Retain the main two-image RAF queue default. Immediate delivery reduces one measured queue component but shows opposing visible-FPS pair results and no strict 60-FPS leg. The original queue is restored after the control.
limits: Measured main queued-image age is one component of presentation delay, not physical input-to-photon latency. The emulator worker still has its own queue and CPU pressure. RAF image sampling cannot guarantee physical scanout timing.
